name: 我的女孩们 - Myriad Melodies
detailed_description:
《Myriad Melodies》​​

《Myriad Melodies》 is a romance-focused role-playing game set in a modern urban backdrop. Players take on the role of a greenhorn entering the workforce, encountering five distinct girls. Through immersive first-person storytelling, rich romantic interactions, and multi-sensory gameplay mechanics, the game delivers a novel and captivating experience.

​​【First-Person Cinematic Storytelling】​​
Experience film-quality, first-person narratives that make every pivotal moment with her feel vivid and real. Feel the warmth of her breath, the authenticity of her presence—from chance encounters to heart-racing dates, each gameplay segment is designed to accelerate your pulse and deliver an ultra-realistic romantic simulation.

​​【Multi-Branching Romance】​​
With numerous branching storylines, every choice you make leads to drastically different outcomes! Will the billionaire CEO abandon her fortune for true love at your word? Or will you seize the opportunity to inherit her empire? The fate of these women rests entirely in your hands.

​​【A World of Enchanting Heroines】​​
Beyond the main story, a myriad of heroines await your discovery! Encounter them across different worldviews, trigger random events, and shape their affections through your decisions—until you successfully win their hearts! Unlock their profiles to set your favorite girl as your home screen mascot, keeping the spark of love alive.

The pink invitation is in your hands, and these captivating girls eagerly await your arrival. Are you ready to embark on this ambiguously sweet journey?

short_description: Office of Exes: Survive the Romance Warzone!​​ Land a new job—only to find it’s run by your exes! A CEO who still simmers for you, an intern who’s all yours… As office politics twist into romantic chaos, charm your way through the drama—and uncover the truth behind your lost memories.
